note: New Phase C lines still to record when the ElevenLabs free plan resets. Run: node scripts/voice.mjs --spare 500 (highest priority first). Speakers without a cast voice (zizzy, nettle) are skipped until they get one in cast.json.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I shoot, I track, and I'm told I'm very good company. Mostly by myself, but still.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Do you mind if I sit? The fire is better company than the dark.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Every floor, I find a little of him. Tally marks. A boot. I haven't told anyone I talk to the marks.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: You're soaked through. So am I. Don't look; I'm not at my best when I'm dripping.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I found his lantern, hung above the tide line. Still tended. He was still being careful.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I find that comforting and unbearable, both.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Every crystal down here shows me what I want. Then takes it back.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: One of those reflections smiled at me with his face.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I know it's only the glass. I know. It still lands.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Ember light suits you. I mean that as a compliment. Mostly.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Can I ask something? Is there someone waiting for you up top? A family? A person you write to?

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Whatever the vault holds, I'd like to have asked something first, so I don't wonder for another twenty years.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I'm staying in Emberhollow. If the Knight will have me.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I'll keep the lantern lit in my window. And maybe, if you ask nicely, keep your fire company too.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Thank you for walking me to him. Whatever comes next, I'm glad you were beside me.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Five-bar tally marks scratched low on the wall. That's the Watch's count. Dad was here.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Twenty-nine days of marks. Then they stop. I want to know why.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: A lantern hangs above the tide line, its wick still fresh. Someone has tended it.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Someone. Or something kind. I'd settle for either.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: A journal page, tucked in a crystal seam: "The seals hold only if the sixth is kept."

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Sixth? There are five. Isn't that the whole point?

items.speaker: liora
items.text: A Watch sword, laid in the cooling trough. His grip-wrap. Not broken. Left.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Like he put it down on purpose. Like he had somewhere to be.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Dad's boots, at the foot of the stair. Side by side. Neat, like him.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I think he walked the rest of the way barefoot. That's exactly like him.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: ...Thank you. Most people want me to cheer up.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: You're very easy to talk to. Annoyingly easy.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Ha! He would have loved you. Terrible taste, my father.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Thank you. I needed to laugh more than I knew.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Don't promise what the dark might not give back.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: ...But I'll hold you to it. Gently. With a bow.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: A cloak. A hero's cloak. You smell like campfire and rat.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Keep smelling exactly like that. It's very warm, thank you.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: You're good at this. The quiet. Don't let anyone talk you out of it.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Oh, you are going to pay for that. Slowly. In small, annoying ways.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Your hand's warm. ...Okay. I can look now.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Don't let go yet. Not until the crystals stop.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: That's smooth. Ridiculous. Do it again later.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I may have blushed. It was the crystals. Obviously.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Practical. Fair. Thank you for not letting me spiral.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Careful. I'm very good at keeping the things I find.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: That might be the nicest thing anyone has said to me in the dark.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I'll take it. I'll keep it.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Mm. Deflecting. I see you. I'll let you off. This once.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Yes. Obviously yes.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Beside me. I can do beside.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Deal. I'll hold the sun up myself if I have to.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Quiet in here. Quiet that's been practising.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Fresh tracks near the wall. Keep your eyes up.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Look at the floor dust. Someone passed here recently. Or something wearing boots.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Dad always said to check every chest twice. I'll hold your torch.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: A nice find. Keep what helps, leave what haunts you.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: A hidden door. Dad would have been so smug. Let's be smug for him.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I knew that wall was wrong. I just wanted you to feel clever.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: That one's dangerous. We go slow, we go together.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Stay close. It watches the corridor, but it hasn't seen the bow yet.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Smell that? Bread and woodsmoke. It's nice to be reminded what we're fighting for.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I'll light the lantern in my window, just in case. Old habit.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Arrows nocked. Let us make this quick.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Stay behind me. Or in front. Honestly, I'll shoot around you.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Right. Time to earn the sun on my clasp.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: One less thing in the dark.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Clean shot. Don't tell the others I'm pleased.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Straight through the eye. I do love a bright day.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Oh, that felt good.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Ow. Rude.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Fair. I'd have done the same.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I'm fine. I'm... mostly fine.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Somebody tell the floor to stop hitting me.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Now THAT was worth the climb.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Shiny. Dad always said to check every chest twice.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Deeper. He went this way. I can feel it.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: One more stair. One more step closer.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I'll take first watch. I don't sleep much down here anyway.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Come sit by the fire. It's the one warm thing in this whole place.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I SAW that. I was just choosing to be brave about it.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Dad's lessons: step light, curse softly.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Well fought, all of you. Truly.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Another one down. I could get used to this.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Stronger, and still not close enough to him. But closer.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: A hidden door. Dad loved those. He would be so smug.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I know this kind of silence. Someone was here recently, or never left.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Mind the shadows. And the floor. And, well, everything.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: The Watch taught me to read tracks. Dad taught me to read people. Only one of those is any use in a dungeon.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: I keep a lantern lit for him back home. Marga thinks it's for the inn. I let her.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Half-elf means two families that never quite fit me. So I made a third out of whoever shows up. Hello.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: Do you ever notice how the rats are polite? They only bite when you stop looking.

items.speaker: liora
items.text: If I ever sing, it's the wind. Agreed? Good.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: I wrote Mum a letter before we left. "Dear Mum, I'm in a cave. Love, Brambur."

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: I didn't send it. She'd only worry. She'd also send soup.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: This water reminds me of the font where Mother Pellwen blessed me. It was this cold.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: I cried. She said that's how you know it took.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: I said a prayer for the rats. And the mirrors. Is that strange?

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: Mother Pellwen says every creature deserves one prayer. I save the spares for us.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: That hammer of Mum's. It'll be somewhere near here, won't it? The Ashforge.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: I won't hit anyone with it. Probably. Maybe once.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: If we don't come back, tell Mum I was brave. Lie if you must.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: Actually, tell her I apologised to the dragon. That'll make her laugh.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick has been informed he is "a bit much." Fizzwick has chosen to be flattered.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: ...Fizzwick is flattered. Mostly.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick's thesis was laughed at by the Academy. It was correct. Fizzwick has the scorch marks to prove it.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: It was about fire. Their roof, specifically.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick sees himself in these crystals. Brilliant, faceted, and slightly cracked.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick will deny having said that.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick admits the forge is magnificent. Fizzwick does not admit he is sweating.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick is merely... glistening.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Should Fizzwick fall here, he asks that his footnote be larger than the others.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: And that someone read it aloud. With feeling.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Fun fact: I stole my first spoon at six. My mum wept with pride.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Then she made me give it back. Then I stole it again.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Spoon count: zero. But I found a very good fork. It's a start.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: A fork is just a spoon with ambition.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: I grew up with eleven cousins and one spoon. You learn to be quick.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: I still sleep with it under my pillow. Don't tell the others.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: The Spoon-Keepers say a hero's measure is what they leave on the table.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: I always leave a spoon. Mostly mine.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: If I find that armory, I'll share it. A little. We'll discuss terms.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: I'd share all of it, actually. Don't repeat that.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Verse one: "Oh rat, oh rat, you gnawed my boot."

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: It gets better. It does not get shorter.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: I failed my bardic audition. They said my dirges were "too much." The audience wept.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Which was the point, no?

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: A crystal sings one note forever. I envy that. I can't hold a note longer than my temper.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Fine. Longer than that. Barely.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Verse four is a battle verse. I'm not sure I'm brave enough to write it.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: I shall be brave. After one more mope.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: I'll finish the ballad tonight. Whatever happens tomorrow, it has an ending.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Even if the ending is: Grumsh hit it very hard.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Confession: I lost my eyebrows at a wedding. Not mine. I was a guest.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: There was cake. The cake was fine.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Water is fire's rival. I respect that. I'll still try to boil it.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Gently. For science.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: These crystals focus light! Which means they can focus FIRE!

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: I know because of the eyebrows.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Home! Not home, but this is the first place that smells like my kitchen!

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: I burned that down too. Great memories.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: I never had friends who stayed when I lit something. You all stayed.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Thanks. Truly. Can I light something now?

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Form 7-B: Application to Exist in a Cave. Filed.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Approved. Naturally.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: My clan forged a decree to exile me. I have written to the Registrar eleven times.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: The Registrar is, regrettably, a goat.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: I cannot be certain the decree was forged. I can only be sure.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Certainty is not paperwork, but it is close.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: I have never missed a deadline. I may miss the end of the world.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: I am preparing a form for that.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: If I fall, stamp me PROCESSED. And add "with honour." In ink.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Pencil is for people who plan to be erased.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: I once fought a hundred rats. Two. One was a ghost rat.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: ...Fine, it was one rat. It bit my boot.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: I've never told a true story to a crowd. They always want the dragon one.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: I'd tell the real one to you, if you'd keep it.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: A mirror and a bard: bad combination. All those versions of me, arguing.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: I came out ahead in every one. Most of them.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: I wrote songs about a hundred heroes. None of them knew me.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: You all know me. It's a strange feeling. A good strange.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: If you ever sing about this, make me taller. Or at least give me better hair.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: And mention I carried the morale. On my back. Like a small mule.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: Nice room. Is it safe? It never is. Lovely.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: I'll just say hello to the walls, so they know we're friendly.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: Is it me, or is this room judging us? Sorry, room.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: I'll write a thank-you note to whoever left this. Posthumously.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: Is it wrong that I'm a little excited? Don't tell Mother Pellwen.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: A secret! I do hope nobody lived in there. Sorry if they did.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: Hidden doors are just doors that are shy. Hello, shy door.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: Oh no. That one is bigger than the others. Sorry. I'll pray quietly.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: We could... not? We could very much not.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: Home! Sort of. Nobody here wants to eat us, which is lovely.

items.speaker: brambur
items.text: Fresh air, no scratching, and Marga's pie. Heaven.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick approves of the proportions. They are almost as grand as Fizzwick.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: The acoustics are splendid. Fizzwick shall test them by being brilliant.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: A chamber! Fizzwick shall make a note, and then a bigger note about himself.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick has appraised it. Verdict: Fizzwick's, with minor concessions.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: A fine acquisition. Fizzwick will mention it in his memoirs, chapter eleven.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick suspected a hidden passage all along. He was merely waiting for a witness.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Observe: a concealed door. Fizzwick has discovered it with his eyes. Mostly.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick has identified a significant threat. Fizzwick will be standing behind someone.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Statistically, this is where Fizzwick suggests a strategic retreat. Statistically.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Emberhollow! Where Fizzwick's genius is, regrettably, underappreciated.

items.speaker: fizzwick
items.text: Fizzwick shall now bathe in adoration. Or at least a warm bath.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Ooh, a room with no cutlery. Disappointing, but gorgeous.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Anyone else feel watched? No? Just me? I'll check the corners.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Nice room. Good bones. Bad spoons.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Mine, mine, mine. I mean, ours! Ours, ours, mine.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: That's a fine find. I'd say it's spoon-adjacent.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Hidden doors are just treasure with manners.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Ha! Called it. I called it in my head. Loudly.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Big one. Nope. Nope nope. I'll be the one holding the door.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Remember: when it chases us, I run fastest. You're welcome.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Smell that? Bread, smoke and other people's spoons. Home.

items.speaker: pip
items.text: Town! I'll just... browse. Innocently. Everything.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Another hall for the dead to echo in.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: I hear a verse in this room. A sad one.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Quiet halls make loud poets. Please excuse me.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Gold for a dirge. Fair trade.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Shiny things, brief joy. Write that down.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: A secret: the oldest rhyme there is. Behind every wall, another wall.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Hidden, but not forgotten. Like most of my poetry.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: The big one. Good. A hero's song needs a worthy verse.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: I shall hum it a dirge before it falls. Out of respect.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: A town. People. I'll hum quietly so they don't flee.

items.speaker: grumsh
items.text: Warm ale and loud laughter. The only verse I can't write.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Wide open space! Perfect for explosions!

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Look at all the flammable stuff! Not that I'm looking. I'm looking.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: New room, new ways to set things on fire. I mean, new ways to admire it.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Ooh, shiny! Does it go boom? Can it go boom?

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Loot! Rate: seven out of ten. Would explode again.

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: A secret room! Statistically, there's something flammable in it!

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Hidden door found! Can I knock on it with a fireball? Gently?

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: That one looks very flammable. Or very not. Let's find out!

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Big monster! Big boom! It's like we planned it!

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Town! Everything smells like bread and "please don't set me on fire". Home!

items.speaker: zizzy
items.text: Hello, Emberhollow! I promise to be only a little bit explosive.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Room surveyed. No permits on display. Suspicious.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Entering an unlicensed chamber. I shall file a report in triplicate.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Floor plan acceptable. Ceiling: pending review.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Recovered goods. Logged. Stamped. Mine. Ours. Logged.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Item received. Chain of custody: us.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: A concealed passage with no signage. Outrageous. Fascinating.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Hidden door located. Form 12-S: Notice of Discovery. Filed.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Hostile of exceptional rank. Form 9: Notice of Imminent Violence. Filed.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: A notable adversary. I shall treat it with the honour it is owed.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Emberhollow. Forms are processed here on time. I approve.

items.speaker: vexrath
items.text: Municipal lighting inadequate. Morale: acceptable.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: I once hosted a banquet in a room just like this. Mostly ghosts.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: Fun fact: I designed this style of ceiling. Possibly.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: Hush. I smell a good story, or a bad cheese. Either way.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: I once found a chest like this and gave it to a queen. She never gave it back.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: That is exactly the kind of loot that makes a ballad worthwhile.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: Hidden door! A bard's favourite words: "I knew there was a story here."

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: A secret passage. I'll tell this one later, with improvements.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: Big fellow. I once wrestled one of those. It was a tie. I won.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: That one looks like the third act of a tragedy. Let's skip to the comedy.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: Ah, the sweet sound of strangers who owe me a drink.

items.speaker: nettle
items.text: Town! I'll be around the tavern, being modest.
